modelDetails.name: GenRA Read-Across Workflow
modelDetails.description: Generalized read-across workflow combining analogue search, evidence weighting, and prediction synthesis.

intendedUse.summary: Supports regulatory read-across decisions for data gap filling and hazard assessment.
inScope: Organic chemicals with available ToxCast/ToxVal analogues
limitations: Requires SME review when analogue similarity < 0.7.
warnings: Document evidence narrative before external submission.

definedEndpoint.description: Endpoints inherited from analogue dataset (e.g., repeat-dose toxicity LOAEL)

unambiguousAlgorithm.summary: Analogue search using structural fingerprints, evidence scoring across data streams, Bayesian-weighted prediction aggregation.

definedApplicabilityDomain.summary: Assess analogue availability, structural similarity, and metadata completeness before generating predictions.

mechanisticInterpretation.summary: Evidence weighting prioritizes analogues sharing mode-of-action descriptors and toxicity pathways.

dataset.name: GenRA Analogue Library 2025
dataset.description: Curated analogue relationships with experimental endpoints

trainingData.preprocessing: Harmonized identifiers, removal of conflicting analogue evidence, assignment of mode-of-action tags.

applicabilityDomain.summary: Composite checks for analogue similarity, data completeness, and evidence diversity.

criteria.description: At least three structural analogues with Tanimoto similarity >= 0.7.
Analogues must span at least two evidence domains (in vivo, in vitro, in silico).
Mode-of-action tags must align across selected analogues.

risks: Analogues may introduce hidden biases when evidence base is uneven.
mitigations: Require documentation of analogue selection rationale and SME oversight.
ethicalConsiderations.humanOversight: SME approval mandated for final predictions and evidence narratives.
